target_label: Semantic responsive HTML canonical content layer
language_variety: All written languages; page content and metadata require localization
script_orthography: Unicode and local-script support; carrier is script-neutral
territory_community: Global; instantiate and test by language, locale, device, and assistive-technology stack
modality: semantic responsive HTML with keyboard-operable interaction
learner_stage_scope: early childhood-primary-secondary-TVET-higher education-adult and lifelong learning
population_definition: No defensible beneficiary denominator: this cross-language carrier serves multiple overlapping disability, device, and language-access cohorts.
overlap_definition: Global overlay; overlaps every population-specific intervention and must not be added to disability or connectivity estimates.
baseline_access_status: WCAG conformance and semantic markup are implementation baselines, not proof of interoperability or educational-task access.
notes: evidence_source_ids=W3C_WCAG22_2024|W3C_REFLOW_ND|W3C_TARGET_ND; target WCAG 2.2 AA, 320-CSS-pixel reflow, and applicable 24-by-24-CSS-pixel target-size test; manual keyboard, screen-reader, zoom, and mobile testing remains necessary

language_variety: All written languages; text, navigation, metadata, pronunciation, and directionality require localization
script_orthography: Unicode HTML/CSS/SVG package; local script and directionality requirements apply
territory_community: Global; instantiate and test by language and reading-system ecosystem
population_definition: No defensible single global print-disability prevalence estimate; WIPO defines the beneficiary group functionally rather than epidemiologically.
overlap_definition: Overlaps blindness, low vision, dyslexia, motor disability, cognitive conditions, offline use, HTML, audio, braille, and MathML; no additive count is valid.
baseline_access_status: A valid EPUB package can still fail in older reading systems; actual WCAG version and level, package validation, metadata, navigation, and device interoperability must be reported.
notes: evidence_source_ids=W3C_EPUB33_2023|W3C_EPUBA11Y11_2023|WIPO_MARRAKESH_2013; reflowable layout is the default; fixed layout needs an educational justification

target_label: Navigable full text synchronized with narration
language_variety: Any written and spoken language/variety; narration, pronunciation, accent, names, mathematical speech, and code-switching require local QA
script_orthography: Written script plus timed spoken-language track
territory_community: Global; instantiate by written/spoken language pair and learner community
modality: synchronized text and audio with structured navigation, replay, and speed control
learner_stage_scope: early literacy-primary-secondary-adult basic education-second-language learning-higher education
population_definition: Random-effects pooled developmental-dyslexia prevalence in primary-school children; 95% CI 6.27%-7.97%; studies searched through June 2021; I-squared 97.6%; proxy only, not an all-age user count.
overlap_definition: The dyslexia percentage is a bounded school-stage proxy and overlaps print disability, low literacy, language learning, and visual disability; the intervention also serves people outside that measure.
baseline_access_status: Audio without synchronized full text loses spelling, tables, equations, and visual structure; long works need hierarchical navigation and granular seeking.
notes: evidence_source_ids=YANG_DYSLEXIA_2022|DAISY_FORMAT_ND|W3C_EPUB33_2023|W3C_WCAG22_2024; evidence is a meta-analysis published in 2022 from studies searched through June 2021; do not extrapolate the rate to all ages or a global headcount

target_label: Localized closed captions for prerecorded instructional media
language_variety: Any written language matching or deliberately translating the media; language tags and subject terminology require localization
script_orthography: Localized written captions; not a signed language
territory_community: Global; instantiate by media language, learner language, and subject
learner_stage_scope: early childhood-primary-secondary-TVET-higher education-adult and lifelong learning
population_definition: WHO estimate of people with disabling hearing loss requiring rehabilitation, defined here as greater than 35 dB in the better-hearing ear; this is not a caption-user count.
overlap_definition: Repeated hearing-loss proxy intentionally overlaps live captions, transcripts, sign-language users, and other accommodations; it must not be summed across rows.
baseline_access_status: Speech, relevant non-speech sound, speaker identity, on-screen text, symbols, and units must be complete; subtitles without sound information are not necessarily captions.
notes: evidence_source_ids=WHO_HEARING_2026|W3C_WCAG22_2024; WHO fact sheet updated 3 March 2026 does not state an estimate reference year; captions are written-language resources and do not replace a named sign language

target_label: Localized live captions for synchronous instruction
language_variety: Any written language matching or deliberately translating the session; subject terminology and speaker attribution require local production
script_orthography: Localized written captions; not a signed language
territory_community: Global; instantiate by session language, learner language, and subject
modality: live captions for synchronous audio and video
population_definition: WHO estimate of people with disabling hearing loss requiring rehabilitation, defined here as greater than 35 dB in the better-hearing ear; this is not a live-caption-user count.
overlap_definition: The same hearing-loss proxy is repeated, not added; it overlaps prerecorded captions, transcripts, named sign-language users, and users outside clinical thresholds.
baseline_access_status: Live latency, speaker attribution, terminology, mathematical symbols, and correction behavior require separate measurement; aggregate word accuracy is insufficient.
notes: evidence_source_ids=WHO_HEARING_2026|W3C_WCAG22_2024; WHO fact sheet updated 3 March 2026 does not state an estimate reference year; WCAG 2.2 Level AA includes live captions for synchronized media

target_label: Downloadable full transcript for instructional audio or video
language_variety: Any written language matching or deliberately translating the media; language tags and subject terminology require localization
territory_community: Global; instantiate by media language, learner language, and subject
learner_stage_scope: early childhood-primary-secondary-TVET-higher education-adult and lifelong learning
population_definition: WHO estimate of people with disabling hearing loss requiring rehabilitation, defined here as greater than 35 dB in the better-hearing ear; this is not a transcript-user count.
overlap_definition: Repeated nonadditive hearing-loss proxy; transcripts also overlap low-bandwidth, search, translation, second-language, and cognitive-access cohorts.
baseline_access_status: A transcript must include all instructional speech, relevant sound, speaker changes, and on-screen information and remain downloadable independently of high-bandwidth media.
notes: evidence_source_ids=WHO_HEARING_2026|W3C_WCAG22_2024; WHO fact sheet updated 3 March 2026 does not state an estimate reference year; transcript is a written-language alternative, not a substitute for synchronized captions or a named sign language

target_label: Instructional video in one named national or regional sign language, paired with text and captions
language_variety: NAMED SIGN LANGUAGE REQUIRED; instantiate one candidate per identified language and variety
script_orthography: Signed language; not a written-script overlay and not International Sign by default
territory_community: Named Deaf community and territory must be specified before implementation
modality: named local sign-language video synchronized to instructional content, paired with text/captions/audio
population_definition: No language-specific denominator is available in the global report. The UN contextual figure of more than 70 million deaf people across more than 300 sign languages cannot be assigned to any named-language candidate and is not interchangeable with WHO hearing-loss counts.
overlap_definition: Must be measured separately for each named sign language and community; hearing-loss proxies, captions, International Sign, and other sign languages are not substitutes or additive denominators.
baseline_access_status: A fluent local signer must render concepts rather than words; face, hands, torso, contrast, adjustable size, synchronization, and compressed downloadable segments require verification.
notes: evidence_source_ids=UN_SIGN_LANG_ND|UNICEF_ADT_REQ_2019|UNICEF_SIGN_GUIDE_2019; template is deliberately unrankable until a named language, variety, territory, and population measure are supplied

target_label: Localized plain-language version alongside the precise source
language_variety: Any target written language; rewriting and cultural examples must be local rather than mechanically translated
territory_community: Global; instantiate by language, literacy context, subject, and community
modality: plain-language text with predictable structure and explained terminology
learner_stage_scope: foundational learning-TVET-health and safety education-adult basic education-older-adult learning
population_definition: UIS 2025 global estimate of adults aged 15+ lacking basic literacy skills; underlying literacy data are largely self- or proxy-declared and may understate functional difficulty; proxy only.
overlap_definition: Literacy proxy overlaps cognitive disability, dementia, language impairment, limited instructional-language proficiency, digital skill gaps, and stress; it is not a plain-language-demand count.
baseline_access_status: Plain language must preserve meaning, explain technical terms, and be tested as a localized version; English readability formulas and grade thresholds do not transfer reliably across languages.
notes: evidence_source_ids=UNESCO_LITERACY_2025|UNESCO_ILD_2025|ISO_PLAIN_2023|W3C_COGA_2021; advanced material may need a plain summary alongside rather than instead of the precise source

target_label: Localized Easy Read version with supportive images and reduced memory load
language_variety: Any target written language; Easy Read conventions and images require local cultural and linguistic adaptation
script_orthography: Target-language script plus supportive images or symbols
territory_community: Global; instantiate by language, cognitive-access context, subject, and community
modality: Easy Read text and image version
learner_stage_scope: foundational learning-public and safety information-procedural TVET-adult and older-adult learning
population_definition: Pooled intellectual-disability prevalence per 1,000 population from 52 population-based studies published 1980-2009; 95% CI 9.55-11.18; heterogeneous definitions, ascertainment, settings, ages, and income groups.
overlap_definition: The dated intellectual-disability rate is not an Easy Read uptake measure and overlaps plain language, dementia, literacy, language impairment, and supported-interaction needs.
baseline_access_status: Easy Read has no single global convention; comprehension, navigation, images, literal language, error recovery, and memory demand require local verification beyond surface readability.
notes: evidence_source_ids=MAULIK_ID_2011|W3C_COGA_2021; population_reference_year records the source-study publication range, not the 2011 meta-analysis publication year; do not convert the rate to a current headcount

target_label: Navigable eBraille and embossable braille in a declared language and specialist code
language_variety: One named written language and braille code per edition; contraction level and specialist code must be declared
script_orthography: Language-specific braille code; mathematics and music may require additional specialist codes
territory_community: Global; instantiate by language, country convention, subject code, and available hardware
modality: navigable eBraille or BRF plus embossable braille output
population_definition: No defensible global braille-reader or device-access denominator is available; blindness prevalence is not a braille-usage count.
overlap_definition: Overlaps blindness, deafblindness, print disability, tactile graphics, audio, and structured e-text; no impairment estimate may be treated as braille demand.
baseline_access_status: Braille codes vary by language, country, contraction level, and subject; actual display/embosser verification and hardware availability remain separate constraints.
notes: evidence_source_ids=WORLD_BRAILLE_2013|LOC_BRAILLE_ND|WIPO_ABC_ND|CRPD_ART24_2006|WHO_UNICEF_AT_2022; World Braille Usage documents 133 languages and 137 alphabet-and-punctuation codes, not a user population

target_label: Tactile graphics for spatial instructional diagrams
language_variety: Localized labels in one declared written/braille language; tactile geometry itself is not a language
script_orthography: Tactile line, texture, label, and declared braille code
territory_community: Global; instantiate by curriculum, diagram type, braille convention, and production method
modality: tactile graphic with structured text description
learner_stage_scope: early learning-primary-secondary-TVET-higher education-STEM-geography and vocational learning
population_definition: No defensible global tactile-graphics user denominator is available; blindness prevalence is a contextual impairment proxy, not a tactile-format-use count.
overlap_definition: Overlaps blindness, braille, text descriptions, audio descriptions, MathML, and other formats; no impairment estimate may be treated as tactile-graphic demand.
baseline_access_status: Spatial fidelity, scale, labels, legend, production durability, and the declared braille code must be verified; a prose description does not always replace spatial exploration.
notes: evidence_source_ids=IAPB_VISION_2020|IAPB_VISION_DEFS_ND|CRPD_ART24_2006; IAPB's 43-million blindness estimate remains contextual and is deliberately not entered as this intervention's population

language_variety: Cross-language mathematical structure; speech rules, variable names, decimal conventions, directionality, and braille math codes require locale-specific QA
script_orthography: MathML plus local written script and declared braille math code where used
territory_community: Global; instantiate by language, locale, subject, browser, reading system, and assistive-technology stack
modality: native navigable MathML with meaningful source or intent where available
learner_stage_scope: secondary-TVET-higher education-research; early numeracy where symbolic notation is used
population_definition: No defensible global denominator measures learners who require accessible mathematical notation; the intervention is subject- and task-specific.
overlap_definition: Overlaps blind, low-vision, print-disabled, braille, audio, tactile, and STEM cohorts; it is a technical layer, not an additive population.
baseline_access_status: Browser-engine support is broad, but speech, navigation, braille, and older EPUB reading-system support vary; equation screenshots or pronunciation-only alt text are not equivalent to navigable math.
notes: evidence_source_ids=DAISY_MATHML_ND|W3C_MATH_CHARTER_2023; test target browser-reader-screen-reader combinations and provide tactile or structured-data alternatives for spatial diagrams

target_label: Concise and extended text descriptions for meaningful instructional images
language_variety: Any target written language; descriptions require subject expertise and localization
script_orthography: Target-language text associated programmatically with each visual
territory_community: Global; instantiate by language, curriculum, image type, and delivery format
modality: programmatic concise and extended text alternatives
learner_stage_scope: early childhood-primary-secondary-TVET-higher education-adult and lifelong learning
population_definition: Approximate number of blind people in the 2020 VLEG/GBD vision-loss model; proxy only and not a count of text-description users.
overlap_definition: Blindness proxy is repeated and nonadditive; descriptions also serve low-vision, print-disabled, low-bandwidth, and search users and overlap tactile and audio descriptions.
baseline_access_status: Descriptions must convey instructional purpose, relationships, labels, units, and data without replacing accessible source data or tactile/spatial alternatives where those are needed.
notes: evidence_source_ids=IAPB_VISION_2020|W3C_WCAG22_2024|UNICEF_ADT_ND; the 43-million proxy must not be added to other vision-format rows

target_label: Localized audio description for instructional video and essential visuals
language_variety: Any spoken language/variety; terminology, timing, pronunciation, and voice require local production
territory_community: Global; instantiate by media language, learner language, subject, and playback system
learner_stage_scope: early childhood-primary-secondary-TVET-higher education-adult and lifelong learning
population_definition: Approximate number of blind people in the 2020 VLEG/GBD vision-loss model; proxy only and not a count of audio-description users.
overlap_definition: Blindness proxy is repeated and nonadditive; overlaps low vision, text descriptions, tactile graphics, captions, transcripts, and synchronized narration.
baseline_access_status: Description must fit the media timing while preserving instructional actions, spatial relations, labels, units, and on-screen text; it should remain selectable and available offline.
notes: evidence_source_ids=IAPB_VISION_2020|W3C_WCAG22_2024; the 43-million proxy must not be added to other vision-format rows

target_label: Self-contained downloadable offline accessible learning package
language_variety: All languages; package must preserve every localized text, font, caption, sign, audio, description, MathML, and braille asset
script_orthography: Multi-script package; no remote-font or CDN dependency
territory_community: Global; especially rural, low-income, displaced, home-learning, community-education, and field-based settings
modality: downloadable HTML or EPUB bundle with local-server, USB, SD-card, or memory-card transfer option
learner_stage_scope: early childhood-primary-secondary-TVET-higher education-adult and lifelong learning
population_definition: ITU 2025 modelled estimate of people who did not use the Internet in the previous three months; Internet use, coverage, household access, device ownership, affordability, and skill are distinct measures.
overlap_definition: Offline status cross-cuts every language, disability, age, and format cohort; the 2.2-billion estimate must not be added to any accessibility population.
baseline_access_status: A package is not offline-first unless cold start, all assets, saved progress, local navigation, and accessibility features work with the network disabled on relevant low-end devices.
notes: evidence_source_ids=ITU_FF_2025|ITU_FF_PR_2025|ITU_METHOD_2025|W3C_AUDIOBOOKS_2020|PDLP_CHARTER_2026; report actual bytes, storage, resumability, power assumptions, and device class

target_label: Optional downloadable low-bitrate media variant preserving accessibility content
language_variety: All spoken, signed, and written languages; compression must retain intelligibility, caption sync, sign visibility, and descriptions
script_orthography: Language-specific audio, caption, and video assets in a script-neutral package
territory_community: Global; especially rural and low-income settings with intermittent or expensive connectivity
modality: modular compressed audio and video downloads with resumable transfer
learner_stage_scope: early childhood-primary-secondary-TVET-higher education-adult and lifelong learning
population_definition: No defensible person count follows from ITU affordability or coverage ratios. Coverage, subscription, price, device, skill, and actual use are not interchangeable.
overlap_definition: Cross-cuts all media and disability cohorts; must not be added to offline, hearing-loss, sign-language, or vision estimates.
baseline_access_status: Reducing bitrate must not remove captions, text, audio description, or sign-language visibility; measure bytes, transfer success, intelligibility, synchronization, and operation on locally prevalent devices.
notes: evidence_source_ids=ITU_AFFORD_2025|ITU_COVERAGE_2025|ITU_METHOD_2025|PDLP_CHARTER_2026; ITU 2025 affordability baskets are cost ratios, not population counts

target_label: Reflowed large-print output with user-controlled size, spacing, and contrast
language_variety: Any target written language; font coverage, line breaking, directionality, and orthography require local validation
script_orthography: Target-language large print derived from structured Unicode source
territory_community: Global; instantiate by language, print standard, device, and low-vision user setting
modality: adaptable on-screen large text plus downloadable or printable large-print edition
learner_stage_scope: early childhood-primary-secondary-TVET-higher education-adult and older-adult learning
population_definition: Total people with vision loss in the 2020 VLEG/GBD model: approximately 43 million blind, 295 million with moderate-to-severe distance loss, 258 million with mild distance loss, and 510 million with near vision loss; proxy only.
overlap_definition: Vision-loss proxy overlaps blindness and every vision-specific row, and includes people who may not use large print; it must not be summed with WHO's broader 2.2-billion vision-impairment measure.
baseline_access_status: Large print requires reflow, font and spacing choice, contrast control, non-clipped zoom, and print-layout verification; fixed enlargement without reflow is insufficient.
notes: evidence_source_ids=IAPB_VISION_2020|IAPB_VISION_DEFS_ND|W3C_REFLOW_ND|WIPO_ABC_ND; the 1.106-billion model total is a severity-based proxy, not a large-print demand estimate
